Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

Dsv4.1's moe layers currently run on bf16 activations by default when a batch <= 256 tokens. Setting `AITER_BF16_FP8_MOE_BOUND=0` or `--monokernel-backend amd` switches them to FP8.

InferenceX does not accept changing precision through flags like these, because they also change the precision of the dspark draft layers. ([PR#4238](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4238))

**This PR makes fp8 the default moe activation for V4.1 instead.**

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

The aiter moe runner passes `quant_dtype_a=fp8` to `fused_moe` instead of letting `AITER_BF16_FP8_MOE_BOUND` pick bf16 for small batches. 

**Other models (ex: dsv4) and other platforms are unchanged.**

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

Test with https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono/pull/17.

Server cmd:
```
TORCH_BLAS_PREFER_HIPBLASLT=1 HSA_NO_SCRATCH_RECLAIM=0 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 TRITON_HIP_USE_ASYNC_COPY=0 \
SGLANG_ENABLE_DSV41_ENGRAM_HOST_TABLE=1 SGLANG_DSV41_ENGRAM_HOST_TABLE_LAYOUT=per_rank \
SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT8 \
SGLANG_OPT_HIP_OPUS_SPARSE_PREFILL=true SGLANG_OPT_HIP_FLYDSL_MXFP8=1 \
SGLANG_HIP_FP4_INDEXER_ROWGROUP=1 SGLANG_HIP_DSV41_INDEX_K_PAGE8=1 \
python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path /models/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
  --served-model-name /models/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --trust-remote-code --tp 2 \
  --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --speculative-dspark-block-size 5 \
  --monokernel-backend amd --enforce-shared-experts-fusion \
  --fp8-gemm-backend aiter --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 64 \
  --enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.80 --chunked-prefill-size 16384 --prefill-decode-interval 96 \
  --swa-prefix-tails 1024 --max-running-requests 32 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
```

GSM8k:
```
100%|█████████████████████████████| 1319/1319 [00:49<00:00, 26.57it/s]
Accuracy: 0.899
Invalid: 0.000
Latency: 49.747 s
Output throughput: 2471.309 token/s
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

No impact on perf. Same with setting `AITER_BF16_FP8_MOE_BOUND=0` before.

- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.

     hidden_pad: int = 0
     intermediate_pad: int = 0
     swiglu_limit: float = 0.0
+    # Quantize the activations of MXFP4 experts to MXFP8 at any token count
+    fp8_activations: bool = False
     fused_moe_kwargs: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None
 
 
@@ -256,7 +258,11 @@ def run(
         extra["moe_sorting_dispatch_policy"] = _MOE_SORTING_DISPATCH_POLICY
 
         # gfx950 small-M MXFP4 kernel (on by default, SGLANG_ROCM_SMALLM_MOE=0 disables): same layouts as aiter, bf16 activations.
-        if _SMALLM_MOE_ON and quant_info.w13_weight.element_size() == 1:
+        if (
+            _SMALLM_MOE_ON
+            and quant_info.w13_weight.element_size() == 1
+            and not quant_info.fp8_activations
+        ):
             from sglang.kernels.ops.moe import smallm_moe_gfx950 as _smallm
 
             try:
@@ -291,6 +297,18 @@ def run(
             except _smallm.SmallMMoeUnavailable:
                 pass
 
+        if (
+            quant_info.fp8_activations
+            and is_gfx95
+            and runner_input.hidden_states.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        ):
+            from aiter import dtypes
+            from aiter.ops.flydsl.moe_common import GateMode
+
+            # aiter's A8W4 kernels take interleaved gate/up rows only
+            if extra.get("gate_mode") == GateMode.INTERLEAVE.value:
+                extra.setdefault("quant_dtype_a", dtypes.fp8)
+
         activation = extra.pop("activation", None) if is_gfx95 else None
         if activation is None:
             activation = _aiter_activation(self.config)

             intermediate_pad=getattr(layer, "intermediate_pad", 0),
+            fp8_activations=(
+                self.is_fp4_expert and getattr(layer, "fp8_activations", False)
+            ),
             fused_moe_kwargs=fused_moe_kwargs,
         )
